queries.purpose: Root cause: Payment Success Rate (attempt level) by bank, payment_method, merchant_category, region for both periods
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-16 00:00:00' THEN 'current' WHEN t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-02 00:00:00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00' THEN 'previous' END AS period,
    COALESCE(b.bank_name, 'UNKNOWN') AS bank,
    t.payment_method AS payment_method,
    m.category AS merchant_category,
    t.region AS region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numerator,
    COUNT(*) AS denominator
FROM transactions AS t
LEFT JOIN banks AS b ON t.bank_id = b.bank_id
LEFT JOIN merchants AS m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
WHERE t.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')
  AND ((t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-16 00:00:00') OR (t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-02 00:00:00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00'))
  AND t.region IN ('North')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

facts.text: Payment Success Rate (attempt level) moved from 90.45% (02 Nov 2026 - 08 Nov 2026, n=9,298) to 87.15% (09 Nov 2026 - 15 Nov 2026, n=9,274): -3.30pp (p < 0.001).
Decomposition at bank x payment_method level: within-segment rate effect -1.75pp, traffic-mix effect -1.55pp; sum -3.30pp equals the observed change (residual -6.1e-17).

Counterfactual (previous traffic mix, current segment rates): 88.61% vs 87.15% actual. Measured this way, performance accounts for -1.84pp and mix for -1.47pp; the symmetric split differs only because it shares the interaction term (+0.18pp) equally.
Zenith Bank: traffic share 12.15% -> 26.19%, success rate 80.44% -> 79.91% (below the 88.80% average); mix contribution -1.21pp.
Nova Bank | UPI: success rate 90.36% -> 79.64% (-10.71pp, p < 0.001) on 10.28% of current traffic; rate contribution -1.17pp.
Nova Bank | CARD: success rate 90.73% -> 87.21% (-3.52pp, p = 0.038) on 6.58% of current traffic; rate contribution -0.26pp.
Nova Bank | UPI failures with reason ISSUER_UNAVAILABLE: 8 -> 132 (7.77% -> 68.04% of the segment's failures).
Nova Bank | UPI daily success was well below its previous-period level (90.36%) on 11 Nov, 12 Nov, 13 Nov, 14 Nov.
Raw data gives 85.20% (n=9,486) vs 87.15% (n=9,274) on the trusted view for the current period (-1.95pp); 212 duplicate rows were excluded.
16 Nov is partially loaded (177 attempts vs ~1382/day) and was excluded from relative periods.

hypotheses.text: The deterioration in Nova Bank | UPI is consistent with an issuer or network availability problem (ISSUER_UNAVAILABLE failures rose concentrated on 11 Nov, 12 Nov, 13 Nov, 14 Nov). Infrastructure telemetry is not available in this dataset to confirm it.

Part of the change comes from traffic moving toward Zenith Bank (share 12.15% -> 26.19%), whose success rate is structurally lower but did not itself deteriorate much (80.44% -> 79.91%). A routing change, campaign or merchant onboarding could explain the shift; the data shows the shift, not its cause.

recommendations: Check Nova Bank | UPI issuer/switch availability and error logs for 11 Nov, 12 Nov, 13 Nov, 14 Nov; consider failover routing for this segment while it is degraded.
Review routing rules, campaigns or merchant onboarding that moved traffic to Zenith Bank and quantify the success-rate cost before keeping the change.
Fix the ingestion replay that creates duplicate transaction rows; report only from the trusted view until then.
